Developer applications

Do you want to develop an application that uses the MusicBrainz API? Register an application to generate OAuth tokens. See our OAuth documentation for more details.

You do not have any registered applications.

Digest access authentication

Some applications use a legacy form of authentication called HTTP Digest Access Authentication. This requires us to store a password using an insecure hash function. Rather than storing your MusicBrainz account password this way, we require generating a separate token if you want to use such an application; use this token in place of your password when the application asks for one.

We don’t track which applications are using digest authentication. You can choose to either reset the token, or disable this access method entirely.

Digest authentication is enabled on your account.
